shared_elements: low-relief carving of a creature on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief figures of animals shown in profile with simple outlined bodies, which is the only real correspondence and a fairly generic one. B presents a densely programmed multi-register composition — a row of arched/pillar-like motifs, a zigzag band, a stalking quadruped, birds, snakes and plant-like forms stacked vertically — whereas A shows what appears to be a single isolated creature on an otherwise undecorated natural rock face, with no registers, no accompanying species and no ornamental band.
